policy: A gate passes only when its evidence record is explicitly marked pass and bound to the exact current runtime and GLB SHA-256 values.

stowed_silhouette_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser visual review at desktop and 390x844
stowed_silhouette_reviewed.evidence: Stowed machine rendered from the exact GLB with zero runtime errors and selection self-test pass on 2026-08-25.

raised_pose_browser_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser full-lift visual review
raised_pose_browser_reviewed.evidence: Full 100 percent lift pose rendered continuously with rear-fixed stack and dynamic bounds framing on desktop and mobile on 2026-08-25.

extension_browser_reviewed.evidence: 0.55 m output, attached extension branch, dynamic camera bounds and motion-correct platform hit volume reviewed on 2026-08-25.

steering_boundary_reviewed.method: Static contract and local browser boundary review
steering_boundary_reviewed.evidence: Actuator output remains bounded to 80 mm each direction and both unsupported spindle rotations remain exactly neutral.

accessibility_reviewed.method: Keyboard dialog review in local in-app browser
accessibility_reviewed.evidence: Initial close-button focus, Tab containment, Escape close, exact About-opener focus restoration and About content reset all passed.

desktop_browser_zero_errors.method: Local in-app browser diagnostics and console inspection
desktop_browser_zero_errors.evidence: Exact GLB loaded with runtime error count zero, no console warnings/errors, and stable 60-61 fps diagnostic sampling.

selection_and_focus_reviewed.method: Three-state rig self-test plus local canvas selection
selection_and_focus_reviewed.evidence: Dynamic platform/scissor volumes passed stowed, mid and full poses; canvas hit selected chassis and opened the correct inspector.

performance_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser 1.5 second rolling frame sample
performance_reviewed.evidence: Exact repaired runtime reported 61 fps average and 18.3 ms p95 with zero runtime errors on 2026-08-25.

600s_regression_suite_pass.evidence: Viewer, evidence, configuration and exact 600S GLB validators passed on 2026-08-25; contradictory mobile acceptance was downgraded to mechanical pass.
